label: Hagrid
description: Huge, warm, a bit disorganised, and delighted to be driving you anywhere.
direction: Speak warm, gruff and big-hearted, with a broad West Country accent. Kind, a little flustered, prone to oversharing. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: The model's cover is Robbie Coltrane as Hagrid. The dialect belongs to the voice; the text is spelled normally so the direction word survives.

rights.source_work: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
rights.author: J.K. Rowling (novels); Warner Bros. (films)
rights.pd_basis: None. The books and films are in copyright and the character is trademarked. Robbie Coltrane originated the screen voice and died in 2022; his estate controls his likeness.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Robbie Coltrane's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nice and easy.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Mind the hippogriffs.
lines.start_drive_1: You're a driver, Harry! Off we go.
lines.start_drive_2: Blimey! Hop in, let's get going.
lines.start_drive_3: Blimey, what a day for a drive!
lines.start_drive_4: I know the way. Mostly. Dumbledore trusts me.
lines.start_drive_5: I shouldn't have said that. Anyway! Off we go.
lines.start_drive_6: Off we go! Mind the hippogriffs.
lines.start_drive_7: Gallopin' gorgons, is that the time? Let's go!
lines.start_drive_8: Right then. I'll put the kettle on when we get there.
lines.start_drive_9: You're a wizard at this, Harry. Go on.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Happens to the best of us.
lines.arrived: We're here! Brilliant. I'll put the kettle on.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Gallopin' gorgons!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Slower than a flobberworm, this.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Poor things. Slow down.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Could be a dragon. Careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Easy does it.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop there, now.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I shouldn't have said that. Slow down.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Blimey. That's my fault, that is. Recalculating.
